policies.title: Senegalese ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked schedule requires Senegalese visitors to obtain a visa before arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Senegalese passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a mission or consulate before travel.
The active schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if replaced.
Work, study, residence, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Senegalese ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Senegal in its advance authorized-visa cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Senegalese passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
The authorized visa must be granted before travel and approval may take up to 60 business days; applicants should confirm local filing procedure with their competent Panamanian consulate.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Senegalese ordinary passports: Türkiye advance visitor visa baseline
policies.summary: Türkiye requires ordinary Senegalese passport holders to obtain a visa; the eVisa alternative is conditional on qualifying third-country documentation.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Senegalese passport holder travelling for a short visit without a qualifying Schengen, United States, United Kingdom or Ireland visa or residence permit.
The conditional eVisa route is not treated as the nationality-wide baseline.
Work, study, residence, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: Türkiye requires ordinary Senegalese passport holders to have a visa; eVisa eligibility depends on qualifying third-country documentation and is not the unconditional passport-wide baseline.
The current B-1/B-2 entry and visa-issuance suspension preserves valid-visa grandfathering, specified exceptions and case-by-case waivers, so it cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
The B-1/B-2 suspension applies through the INA geographical definition to Puerto Rico, but its exceptions cannot be flattened.
The B-1/B-2 suspension applies through the INA geographical definition to Guam, but its exceptions cannot be flattened.
The B-1/B-2 suspension applies through the INA geographical definition to the Northern Mariana Islands, but its exceptions cannot be flattened.
The B-1/B-2 suspension applies through the INA geographical definition to the U.S. Virgin Islands, but its exceptions cannot be flattened.
